_readme: Strike tuning. dur/act are seconds (act = window where the hit lands). reach in pixels, dmg in HP, kb = knockback, stun seconds, hs = hit-stop seconds.

counters._readme: Counter windows in seconds. whipReverse = time to press GRAB after being grabbed for a whip. ropeAttack = time after bouncing off the ropes to press PUNCH (flying clothesline) or KICK/JUMP (dropkick). block: hold away from the opponent to block strikes; chip = share of damage still taken, stun = seconds stuck in the block pose, push = share of the strike's knockback. run: double-tap left/right within doubleTap seconds to run at speed; after bouncing off the ropes you keep running for afterRopes seconds. crowd: the crowd meter (0-1). At or above hot, both wrestlers' finisher meters fill meterBonus faster. knockdown/dive/finisher = how much those moments heat the crowd up. perDamage = crowd heat per point of damage; react/reactBig = crowd pops; cool = how fast the crowd cools per second. pinCount/kickout/nearFall = heat from pin counts, regular kick-outs and 2.9 kick-outs (also second winds). coolHot = extra cooling the hotter the crowd is (pops fade unless you keep them going).

dodge._readme: 5-by-5s: range = how far away a runner can be when you dodge; leapVy = leapfrog height; dropTime = seconds flat on a drop down; chainGap = seconds between dodges that still count as a streak; cpu = chance the CPU dodges; cpuAt = how close the CPU lets him get

group._readme: Group matches. rumbleInterval = seconds between Royal Rumble entrants. Over-the-top elimination chance rises as health drops below elimHp, up to elimMax (always at 0 health). lowHpReach: worn-down wrestlers can be knocked over from further from the ropes. stallAfter: seconds with no elimination before the odds start rising.

hardcore._readme: Hardcore match tuning: ladderTop = standing height on the ladder, tableDmg = extra damage going through a table, ladderBonus = extra damage for a ladder dive, cpuWeapon = how often the CPU goes for a weapon (0-1).
